editor.title: Edit the subtitles
editor.files_hint: Double-click to open. A subtitle file (.srt) opens here in the program so you can edit it; right-click to open it in another program. The subtitle files are reused if you make more versions.
editor.hint: Click a line to see the picture. Double-click the text to edit it. Drag the line's edges on the timeline to move its start and end.
editor.no_video: The video is not next to the subtitle file, so there is no picture or sound.
editor.keys: Enter: next line  ·  Shift+Enter: new line in the text  ·  Ctrl+Enter: split at the cursor  ·  Ctrl+Z: undo  ·  F5: play  ·  Ctrl+S: save
editor.backup: The first version is kept in "{backup}".
editor.remake: Videos with burned-in subtitles or a dub must be made again to include the changes.
editor.moved: {n} lines were moved so they do not overlap.
editor.moved_one: {n} line was moved so it does not overlap.
editor.nothing_to_save: There are no changes to save.
editor.unsaved: You have changes that are not saved. Do you want to save them?
editor.split_where: Put the cursor in the text where the line is to be split.
editor.split_short: The line is too short to split.
editor.edge_blocked: The line cannot go further: it meets the next line.
editor.sound_wait: The sound is being prepared. Try again in a moment.
editor.words_title: Add corrected words to the word list?
editor.words_text: You corrected these words in the {plural} subtitles. Tick the ones the program should correct by itself the next time it makes subtitles. Claude is told about them too.
editor.words_added: {n} words were added to the word list.
editor.words_added_one: {n} word was added to the word list.
